title: Potential Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the potential V(r) for both regions (r < R and r >= R).

title: Energy Shift Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy shift ΔE due to the finite size of the nucleus.

title: Numerical Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the final numerical answer for Δν in cm^-1 accurately.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply perturbation theory to find the Hamiltonian for the finite nucleus.

title: Wave Function Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student must appropriately approximate the 1s wave function for the calculations.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear steps in the integration process for calculating the energy shift.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or assumptions made during the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the potential or energy shift.
